_doc: [onboard] The first-minutes story objectives (story/objectives.gd, ui/objective_card.gd). One at a time, in order, each with a one-line why (desc). brief.lines: WREN's one last message in the crash (two subtitle lines), then she is silent until the Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd). Objective fields: text (title), desc (the why), hint (shown instead of desc until wait_flag is set), type stat|robot|zone|hub_level|flag|core|tower|upgrade|bench ([v1guide] the workbench tier, ui/bench_tiers.gd), key, target (absolute: lifetime stats), desc/hint may hold {action} key glyphs, e.g. {cube} ([v1guide]); hex (true: outline the target hex on the ground with its % cleaned), lines (WREN, when the objective starts). Data stays English; tr() at display.

wren_brief._doc: [v2guide] WREN once the signal tower carries her (story/objectives.gd _narrate): who she is and the plan home. Then each new story step speaks its lines[0], once.
lines: Lumi, it's WREN. I keep the Cradle running, and I never stopped listening for you.
The ark is waiting in orbit, but it can't land on a dead world. Make Verdance green again.
Every bloom fills your Bloom Core. When it's full, its light calls the Cradle down, and we go home.
Lumi, it's WREN, up on the Cradle. Your pod's down and the relay's failing. I can barely hear you.
Pick up the junk, look for parts, and build a signal tower so we can talk. I'll be [glitch]listen—[/glitch]

objectives.desc: Each chestful pays cubes toward the signal tower.
lines: Start small, Lumi. Every chestful in the bin adds up.

objectives.desc: A bigger chest means fewer trips to the bin.
lines: A bigger chest means fewer trips. The bench can fit one.

objectives.desc: Grab more junk at once. At the workbench.
lines: A wider scoop. More junk per swing, less walking.

objectives.desc: It presses junk into bales. Bales sell for far more.
lines: Save up for the Baler. Bales sell for far more than loose junk.

objectives.desc: Full chest? Press {cube} for a bale, carry it to the scale.
lines: Carry bales to the scale. Three of them and the base wakes up.

objectives.desc: WREN went silent. Build it in the workbench's Build tab.
lines: Build the tower, Lumi. Then I can stay with you.

objectives.desc: Clean ground is where green can grow again.
lines: First, one clean hex. Clear the outlined one to the last scrap. Green starts on clean ground.

objectives.desc: Three clean hexes earn the workbench its Bot Bay.
lines: Three clean hexes. The planet notices, believe me.

objectives.desc: A bot bay lets you build helpers. Upgrades tab, Base.
lines: Upgrade the bench to a Bot Bay. You shouldn't do this alone.

objectives.desc: A helper keeps cleaning while you work.
lines: The base has power! Enough to build you a helper. Try the Bots tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Press B and paint the hexes it should clean.
lines: Give your robot a hex to work on. It wants a job.

objectives.desc: It carries bales to the scale for you.
lines: A Haul Bug carries bales for you. Build one at the bench.

objectives.desc: Living green charges your Bloom Core.
objectives.hint: Keep clearing ground. Seeds turn up in clean soil.
lines: Something green is waking out there. Plant the first seed.

objectives.desc: A bigger base runs more robots.
lines: The hub can grow now. Rebuild it from the Upgrades tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: A stronger signal: WREN comes through clearer.
lines: Boost the tower. I want to hear you clearly.

objectives.desc: Level 3 lets the workbench take a Request Board.
lines: One more base level. The Cradle is watching, Lumi.
